signatures.description: Uses Windows utilities for basic Windows functionality

T1053.long: Utilities such as at and schtasks, along with the Windows Task Scheduler, can be used to schedule programs or scripts to be executed at a date and time. A task can also be scheduled on a remote system, provided the proper authentication is met to use RPC and file and printer sharing is turned on. Scheduling a task on a remote system typically required being a member of the Administrators group on the the remote system.

file.type: HTML document, ASCII text, with very long lines

strings: I'm one of the International procurement consultants of the Supreme Committee For Delivery and Legacy for the Qatar 2022 FIFA world cup event hosting preparation.

The government of Qatar has approved a massive procurement of different varieties of goods for nationwide distribution to Airports facilities, offices, stadiums, Hostels, Hotels, Shops as part of their national and regional sensitization programs towards the hosting of the FIFA world cup. The products are to be customized with the Qatar 2022 Logo and Top of the list are PPE products.
The Tender is open to all eligible foreign Manufacturers, Exporters and Individuals etc. The funding of this project is captured in the 2021/2022 budgetary allocation to the tender board.

Kindly  confirm from your company's Board of Directors, if they will be interested to participate for the Tender Process for the supply of you product so that we could discuss on our possible collaboration to ensure a successful bidding.
NOTE: You are to attach your product catalog and price(S) with specification and product pictures to enable us select.
For products like coffee, tea and beverages etc the packaging details will be provided to you upon reply.
We are looking forward to hearing from you soon.
